name: llm_nli
description: Prompted LLM NLI baseline for dnli (task_type=nli): asks the model whether the premise persona sentence/utterance entails, contradicts, or is neutral to the hypothesis; scored by nli_accuracy. The zero-shot counterpart to a DNLI-fine-tuned classifier. Defaults to the free local google/gemma-4-31B-it.
author: Wnsdnl
